hints.title: Digit Position Independence
hints.text: Each digit position in the numbers contributes independently to the total difference sum.

hints.title: Digit Frequencies
hints.text: For each digit column from right to left, count occurrences of each digit from 0 through 9.

hints.title: Combinatorial Difference
hints.text: At a given position with digit count array c, pairs with distinct digits equal c[d] * (n - c[d]) summed over all d from 0 to 9, divided by two.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: d: number of digits per integer
complexity.notes: Digit counts array has fixed size 10.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all n^2 pairs directly exceeds time limits for n = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using 10-element bucket counting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize column-wise digit independence and frequency counting.
